mostWorthwhile.text: Making the mosaic was the most worthwhile sequence: breaking glass into pieces and setting them in clay made the construction easy to picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: The gallery construction felt less clear: the arch and planks became an arcade without much explanation.

surprise.text: I expected a building component, but the arch and planks produced an arcade specifically.

arbitrary.text: Combining an arch with planks to make an arcade felt somewhat arbitrary because the role of the planks was unclear.

continue.text: I would be mildly curious to continue for more constructions, though the predictable combinations and menu-guided choices made this chapter only moderately engaging.
